title: Susi's own images name no GitHub registry, and the guard refuses one
goal: Zero-GitHub audit (board item 296): the compose stack tagged Susi's image ghcr.io/intellibitz/susi:latest, a GitHub Container Registry address that breaks when the ecosystem moves host. Compose now tags the image it builds from source as ${SUSI_IMAGE:-susi:local}, and tests/no_github_coupling.rs refuses the literal ghcr.io/intellibitz so it cannot return. Other projects' images on ghcr.io (the GitHub MCP server) are user features and stay.
limitations: docker compose was not run here; the change only renames the tag of the image compose already builds from deploy/compose/Dockerfile.susi.

results.tests: no_github_coupling 5/5 (matcher now finds ghcr.io/intellibitz and ignores ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server)
